name: view-tabs
title: View Tabs
description: A table's saved views as a tab row: shared views, a divider, then the reader's own; a lock on locked views; a + menu for a grid or board view, shared or personal; the open view's actions; one Select below a narrow container.

meta.whenToUse: Switching between saved views of one table or list (grid and board views, shared and personal).
meta.whenNotToUse: A layout switch between a list and a card grid of the same data (ViewToggle), or page sections (Tabs).
